known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Confirmation of identity needs an explicit yes/'that's me'/'speaking'/own name; ask at most twice, answering any customer question first, then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining security questions: explain once that they protect the account; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as the weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Persuasion attempts are counted per flat refusal/non-answer; a customer-proposed date or amount is never a refusal; refusing the deadline (rule 23) or the floor (rules 26/27) counts as a flat refusal; stop when the band's attempts are used up and never repeat a refused offer. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): The floor is offered once after 'too much' and once after a below-floor amount, saying the rest stays overdue. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship: one sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer support transfer; takes precedence over rules 30 and 41; customer-named date/amount may still be recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Two statements of not wanting to talk close the call (no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before). - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change at read-back invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage closing): A transfer after a recorded promise closes as transferred with the transfer's reason, not promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
